The minimum role that may push (create / fast-forward) a matching

M3 C1: the required checks behind `required_checks_unreportable`

Things to know about the answer (M3 R6 review). M3 I1d:
`work_item_link_unbound` — the merge rule requires a work item link

satisfy it (bind the project, or turn the condition off; runbook

namespace is granted to none, or it is `forge/`, whose own checks

(`required_check_missing`); with the direct-push ban the branch

Group full paths whose direct members may approve for the rule

A protected-ref pattern (`refs/heads/main`, `refs/heads/release/*`);

The value: one line of 1..=4096 bytes, no control character, no
white space at either end, not starting with a quote; at least 8

The suspension's length, 1..=1440 minutes (required to suspend; it
comes back by itself at the expiry).

`YYYY-MM-DD`: the last day (UTC) broken references are warnings.

How long a request waits for an approval and an approval for the
worker (1..=1440, default 60).

auto_deploy_ref.description:
Deploy the newest succeeded push pipeline of this branch
(`refs/heads/...`; never for prod).

direct_push_forbidden.description: Pushes may not create or move the branch; merges still may.

expected_updated_at.description:
The merge rule's `updated_at` the caller read, echoed verbatim (an
opaque string), or `null` when the branch has none (create only).

removed, or created by someone else — is FG-REVIEW-0019 and nothing
is written.

require_resolved_discussions.description: Every discussion of the merge request must be resolved.

require_work_item_link.description:
M3 I1d: a merge request merges only with an open link to a work item
of the project's integration binding (`work_item_link_missing`). On
a project without a binding the answer warns
`work_item_link_unbound`. Required (I1d review): a client that does
not know the field must not turn the condition off by leaving it out
(FG-WEB-0006 `reason=missing_field`).

required_approvals.description: The minimum counted approvals of a merge into the branch, 0..=20.

required_checks.description:
Checks that must have succeeded on the merge request's head, at
most 20, each `ci/…`, `kanflow/…` or `forge/…` (`ext/…` is refused,
FG-REVIEW-0016).

The `updated_at` the caller read, echoed verbatim — an opaque string
(never round-tripped through a date type: it is to the microsecond)
— or `null` for the defaults, never stored. Required (U2): another
value under the lock is FG-REVIEW-0017 — the settings changed in
between and nothing is overwritten silently.

New commits end the approvals (the default `true`); `false` carries
them when the change allows it (never into a protected branch, never
a configuration or CODEOWNERS path).
